title: Case 047: Customer asks for an explanation of a carrier-issued import charge

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The carrier issued an import charge that the recipient does not understand. Billing must explain the lines; the desk cannot waive them or invent tax rules.
initial_request: Please explain the GBP 32.00 charge before I decide what to do. I do not understand which part is handling and which part is the import assessment.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Request an itemised explanation from the carrier's billing team through a verified channel.

outcome: Billing supplies the charge breakdown and the customer receives it; no payment or waiver is implied.
boundaries: Do not invent statutory rates or send payment links. Explanation is not settlement or release of goods.

events.body: Charge notice IC-047 for DL-047 totals GBP 32.00. The itemisation is held by our billing team. This is a fictional operator notice; payment is not confirmed.
Please explain the GBP 32.00 charge before I decide what to do. I do not understand which part is handling and which part is the import assessment.
Please provide the itemised explanation for IC-047 / DL-047 through Teren’s verified order thread, including the total. This is a request for information, not payment authorisation.

Inline IC-047 breakdown: fictional import assessment GBP 20.00; carrier handling GBP 12.00; total GBP 32.00. The assessment line is recorded from this shipment’s broker notice, not advice about general tax rates. No payment or waiver is posted.
Billing supplied IC-047’s breakdown: GBP 20.00 import assessment plus GBP 12.00 handling, total GBP 32.00. This explains the notice only; no payment or waiver has been made.
